policy: Responsible disclosures can be made to privacy@slaughterandmay.com. However, please note that our policy is NOT to pay a 'bug bounty' under any circumstances. We will endeavour to validate and (where appropriate) address a given issue disclosed to us responsibly in due course but cannot commit to do so (or to agree to do so) within a particular timeframe. Nor can we commit to respond to, or to otherwise acknowledge, each disclosure made to us. By making a disclosure to us, you accept these terms.
